title: A codon changes
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: UAU encodes tyrosine, while UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. If translated in this reading frame, the new stop ends translation at that point.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: UAU encodes tyrosine, while UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. If translated in this reading frame, the new stop ends translation at that point.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: In the standard genetic code, a codon changes from UAU to UAA. What happens at that position? UAU encodes tyrosine, while UAA is a stop codon in the standard genetic code. If translated in this reading frame, the new stop ends translation at that point.
Recall: Which codon signals stop in the standard genetic code? UAA signals stop; UAU specifies tyrosine and GUA specifies valine.
